privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This draft describes how [COMPANY NAME] intends to handle enquiries. Replace every bracketed item and confirm actual processing before launch.

sections.title: Who is responsible?
sections.body: [COMPANY NAME], [REGISTERED ADDRESS], [KVK NUMBER], is the proposed data controller. Contact: [PUBLIC EMAIL]. Add the correct legal entity and any representative details.

sections.title: Your enquiry
sections.body: We process the name, email, company, phone number and message you provide to respond to your request. Confirm the applicable legal basis for enquiries and any later contractual processing. The checkbox records your acknowledgement; it does not replace a legal-basis assessment.

sections.title: Service providers and transfers
sections.body: The site uses [HOSTING PROVIDER] and Resend for email. Optional Upstash rate limiting and Cloudflare Turnstile must be documented if enabled. Verify processor agreements, sub-processors, processing locations and international transfer safeguards.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: [DEFINE RETENTION PERIODS] for enquiries, email correspondence, security logs and backups. Configure deletion procedures that match these periods.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: No advertising or tracking cookies are enabled by default. A functional NEXT_LOCALE cookie remembers your language for up to one year. If Plausible or Turnstile is enabled, review its configuration, disclosures and any applicable consent requirements.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access, correction, erasure, restriction, portability or objection where applicable. Contact [PUBLIC EMAIL]. You may also complain to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens). Specify identity checks, response procedures and any limitations.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.intro: These draft terms need to be adapted to your services, legal entity and customer contracts before use.

sections.title: Scope and proposals
sections.body: Define the contracting entity, offer validity, acceptance procedure, deliverables, exclusions and precedence between proposals and these terms.

sections.title: Planning and collaboration
sections.body: Agree milestones, customer responsibilities, content delivery, approval periods, accessibility scope, testing and change-request procedures.

sections.title: Fees and payments
sections.body: [DEFINE PAYMENT SCHEDULE, VAT, EXPENSES, LATE PAYMENT AND INDEXATION]. State which third-party subscriptions are paid separately.

sections.title: Ownership and licences
sections.body: Specify intellectual property transfer conditions, rights to customer content, third-party software licences and any portfolio permissions.

sections.title: Maintenance and security
sections.body: Describe included updates, backups, response windows, support hours and exclusions. Do not promise absolute security or availability. Use a separate service agreement where appropriate.

sections.title: Liability and termination
sections.body: [LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED] Define proportionate liability limits, insurance, force majeure, termination, cancellation fees, data handover and dispute resolution under applicable Dutch law.
